_comment: Self-build perf + memory baseline. Track L locks the baseline to the strict-intrin-on 10-sample p50 and the verify ceilings to the observed 10-sample p95/max on this idle Windows machine. Update via tools/check_perf_regression.ps1 -Update only after a justified intentional change; never bump to absorb a regression. Cold = full rebuild from scratch. Hot = immediate re-run with caches warm. Peak memory is process-tree WorkingSet64 for the launched compiler and descendants. The runtime e-stop is a 1024 MB hard kill.
_anti_compound_rule: Each ship must come in at or below the ceilings above. If you observe drift >5% but <10%, investigate before shipping — do not chain small creeps. Never -Update the baseline to absorb a regression; only update when you've intentionally pushed perf in a measured way (e.g., the v0.3.220 13x revert).

_history.note: REVERT: removed strlen from str_substring default
Ceilings tightened from cold=10.0/hot=2.5/mem=700 → cold=7.20/hot=0.86/mem=552 (baseline +10%) to prevent compounding drift. Baseline values unchanged.

Hot baseline updated 0.78 → 0.88 (5x stable measurement, range 0.87-0.89). The 0.78 figure was stale from v0.3.223; current system-state is 0.88 across multiple ships including v0.4.162 (no-edit baseline) and v0.4.164 (TYP-014 simplification). Cold + memory remained well below ceilings (cold 2.99s, mem 131 MB — far below user's stated 6.5s/500MB target). NOT bumping to absorb a regression; bumping to reflect that the prior baseline was inherited from a different system state. New ceiling 0.97s (= 0.88 × 1.10).

Post-RFC-0015-phase-3 baseline (v0.4 closeout). Phase 3a (typed memory ops, v0.4.209/.210), phase 3b (narrow arith chains, v0.4.211/.212/.213), and phase 3d (comprehensive fixture, v0.4.222) shipped over ~14 ships. Phase 3c (typed fn params, v0.4.221) was REVERTED in v0.4.224 because it broke the compiler's own self-build (i32 params got typed-trunc'd, but the compiler abuses the i64-everywhere ABI on its lone i32-param fn `str_from_int(n: i32)`). Phase 3a/3b substrate pushed cold 2.99 → 3.31 (+10%) and hot 0.88 → 1.03 (+17%) via genuine work — typed allocas, sext/zext per narrow var-ref load, narrow binop dispatch, additional typed IR ops emitted per phase 3 site. NOT a regression to absorb: this is the intentional cost of width-correct adopter IR. New ceilings: cold 3.64s (3.31 × 1.10), hot 1.13s (1.03 × 1.10), peak 145 MB (132 × 1.10). Memory stable; no blow-up. Phase 3c v0.5 revisit needs call-site type-info propagation to safely narrow i32 params without breaking i64-ABI abuse patterns.

Track L reset after strict-intrin default plus content-addressed cache v2. Measurement used tools/measure_track_l_perf.ps1 with 10 cold + 10 hot samples per config under a 1024 MB process-tree cap and no global process kills. Env-default strict-intrin-on: cold p50 4.643s, p95 5.928s; hot p50 1.222s, p95 1.743s; peak 679 MB. Env-off: cold p50 4.555s, p95 4.965s; hot p50 1.127s, p95 1.736s; peak 677 MB. Wrapping-everywhere fixture: cold p50 0.708s, p95 1.142s; hot p50 0.648s, p95 1.219s; peak 217 MB. Memory baseline changed from parent-process WorkingSet64 to process-tree WorkingSet64, so the 679 MB number includes compiler descendants and clang rather than only bin/nucleor.exe.
